notes.title: Final Early Access Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, 

sorry for the lack of updates, i had COVID and it took me a while to get back on track. I've been really busy preparing everything for the full release, lots of new waves, better tutorial, UI, overall better performance and stability, localization to German, Japanese, Spanish, Chinese and French.

I've been working on the game for more than five years and time has come to wrap things up. There's a lot more that i'd like to add to the game, but at one point i have to release it. At the moment, i think it provides a lot of fun, especially for the price tag. If the game goes well in terms of sales i will be working on additional content which can be seen on the Roadmap in the Discussions part of the Steam page.

I would like to thank to all the players participating in the early access, you helped made a better game, i hope all of you will enjoy it, both rookies and veterans in the genre.

As always, if you have any bug reports, be sure to report them.

New version is now online, be sure to update it and i hope you will enjoy it. See you on full release.

notes.title: Round of bug fixes, performance improvements and adjustments
notes.notes:
[h1]Bug fixes and performance improvements[/h1]

Fixed Enforcer movement method (sometimes they moved rotated instead fixed).
Fixed Blaster movement method (sometimes they move rotated instead fixed).
Fixed Avenger following a proper horizontal value (so he now shoots straight at you).
Fixed last weapon used still appearing visually on ship upon level restart.
Fixed Ripper homing system not properly deactivating so they end up entering the screen in full speed, not happening anymore.
Fixed Hologram properly functioning when pausing game (it got disabled when unpausing).
Fixed being able to use Hologram, Microwarp and Artillery Strike during the boss appearing sequence which caused issues, they can't be activated during the sequence anymore.
Fixed Bloom to NOT affect menu items.
Infiltrator (one of small enemies with laser sight that is being launched by Terran Boss) now properly targets Hologram.
Fixed Short Fuse and BullHammer mines sometimes not despawning properly.
Added a fail safe for ranks sometimes not being despawned when picked up.
Fixed Sundyne Boss MK1 not following Hologram.
Fixed a lot of stuff for overall stability and performance during longer runs and restarts.
Some cosmetic fixes.

[h1]Adjustments and additions[/h1]

New enemy - Shielded shielder (DUH), still need to make more waves with them.
New enemy - Infiltrator, still need to make more waves with them.
Slowed down Enforcer bullets.
Added Syndyne space warp malfunction.
Lowered Thoraxx Artillery Strike missile damage from 100 to 75 (sorry, it made bosses too easy to dispose of).
Increased Metal Storm bullet damage from 7.5 to 8.5.
Improved Razor firing rate by 33%.
Added sound to huge explosion (when killing bosses and Big Asteroid Cannons).

[h1]Upcoming[/h1]

More bug fixes
Started working on adding weapons and enemies to Steam Guide
Localization coming soon
More shielded enemies and waves coming soon

notes.title: Gameplay tweaks and bug fixes
notes.notes:
[h1]Tweaks[/h1]

[list]
[*] Provoker bullet speed lowered from 1.25 to 1.00
[*] Bloodhound missile damage raised from 13 to 25
[*] Riftminers boss mk3 now shoots 50% less asteroids in asteroid barrage pattern
[*] Updated the progression scale of the levels for faster leveling and going through loops. A small explanation how things work. Every enemy kill gets you (invisible to player) experience points which differ from enemy to enemy. Once you hit the threshold, boss spawns. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/02ql2yC.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/r15HmPZ.png[/img]

With the old, linear system, later levels tend to last too long and there is no cap. With the new system, levels last shorter so the whole thing is more dynamic, plus the progression is capped after level 15.

Warp malfunctions are tied to level length (each warp malfunction lasts half of XP needed for completing the next level) so they are shorter now too.

[h1]Fixes[/h1]

Fixed bloom effect which got broken after the update to new Unity version
Fixed images and weapons names appearing wrong
Fixed some issues with warp malfunction (also lasts shorter)
Fixed dark pact not displaying health properly
Fixed resolution issues, game now supports only 16:9 aspect ratio, up to 1920x1080. Due to technical difficulties i'm unable to support different aspect rations and UHD resolutions at the moment
[/list]

[h1]
Tutorial and controls rebinding are still in the works, slowly getting there. 
Also started laying foundations for translations.[/h1]

As usual per every update, resolution and other settings will probably be reset so you have to adjust them again.

notes.title: Performance update and small bug fix
notes.notes:
[h1]Performance update[/h1]

Project has been updated to Unity 2019 with Incremental garbage collection. Frame rate should not drop below 60 fps, only in rare occurences (boss appearing) when it drops to 30 fps for a frame.

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]

Rippers (second level robots with saws) should no longer bug out and stutter on the left side of the screen.

notes.title: Small update with a big change
notes.notes:
By popular demand, i lowered enemies HP from 15-40%, depending on the enemy. Lots of players find the game too hard and hard mode next to impossible. Since they don't soak up as many bullets now, i will work on the whole game having a faster tempo and better flow.

Metal Storm didn't work on gamepads so that's fixed now too.

Leaderboards are pending, i'm having issues with Steam API, but they are stored on Steam.
